cases.name: CREATE_TWO_MEMBER_CLUSTER
cases.input: A=100.00, B=100.05; distanceATR=0.05; frozen Formation Gate passes
cases.expected: Create EQ#1 [A,B] with immutable anchor A and referencePrice=100.025

cases.name: APPEND_THIRD_MEMBER
cases.input: EQ#1 ACTIVE; C=100.02; anchor A to C is VALID_EQ
cases.expected: Append C to EQ#1; members [A,B,C]; id unchanged; referencePrice=100.0233333333

cases.name: MULTIPLE_CLUSTER_AMBIGUITY
cases.input: D directly passes anchor gates for active EQ#1 and active EQ#2
cases.expected: AMBIGUOUS_UNASSIGNED; append to neither; create no third cluster

cases.name: ANTI_TRANSITIVE_RUNAWAY
cases.input: A-B VALID, B-C VALID, A-C not VALID
cases.expected: Cluster anchored at A remains [A,B]; C cannot append through B
invariants: Every appended member must directly pass against immutable anchor A

cases.name: ACTIVE_APPEND
cases.input: EQ#1 ACTIVE; new Swing passes all frozen gates

cases.name: BROKEN_NO_APPEND
cases.input: EQ#1 BROKEN; new Swing is geometrically compatible
cases.expected: Do not append and do not reopen EQ#1

cases.name: AS_OF_MEMBER_IMMUTABILITY
cases.input: At T1 EQ#1=[A,B]; at T2 append C
cases.expected: Projection as-of T1 remains [A,B]; projection as-of T2 is [A,B,C]

cases.name: REFERENCE_MEAN_CHANGES_ID_DOES_NOT
cases.expected: reference mean changes from 100.025 to 100.0233333333; cluster id and confirmedAt unchanged

cases.name: ACTIVE_MEMBER_EXCLUSIVITY
cases.input: Swing S is already an active member of EQ#1 and is proposed for EQ#2

cases.name: HISTORICAL_SEQUENTIAL_REUSE
cases.input: Old EQ terminal; later two new canonical Swings form at a similar price
cases.expected: May create a new id from the new formation anchor; old cluster remains terminal; no canonical Swing is reused

cases.name: FORMATION_FAIL_NO_APPEND
cases.input: Candidate price passes but departureATR or outside-zone persistence fails

cases.name: BORDERLINE_NO_APPEND
cases.expected: BORDERLINE_EQ remains diagnostic; do not append

cases.name: FUTURE_MEMBER_REJECT
cases.expected: Do not evaluate or append candidate

cases.name: INPUT_ORDER_DETERMINISM
cases.input: Same confirmed Swing/cluster facts supplied in different array order
cases.expected: Canonical sorting and ambiguity policy produce identical ids, member ledger, and projection
